day_titles.3: Ulun Danu and on to Kuta

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your villa resort in the Ubud rice fields
Rest of the day free by the pool
Optional: the Monkey Forest or the Ubud art market
2: Breakfast, then a full day out with your own car and guide
Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani
Tegenungan waterfall and the Tegalalang rice terraces
A turn on the jungle swing above the valley
3: Breakfast and check out, then north to the Handara gate
Ulun Danu Beratan, the temple standing on the lake
The tall Git Git waterfall in the hills
Private transfer down to Kuta and check in
4: Early breakfast, then private transfer to Sanur harbour
Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for the west coast
Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Bay and Bubu beach
Return boat to Bali and back to your hotel
5: Breakfast, then on to the Garuda Wisnu Kencana park
The giant Garuda statue and the park amphitheatre
Padang Padang beach in its limestone cove
Uluwatu temple on the cliffs at sunset
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Five nights, a five star villa in Ubud and a four star on the coast. The hotels are the reason to pick this one.
expert.tip: Ubud Green is spread over a hillside, so ask for a villa near the pool if steps are a problem. On the Nusa Penida day we book the first boat out of Sanur and you are back by six.

summary: Six days with a five star villa in the Ubud rice fields and a four star on the coast, taking in Kintamani, the Ulun Danu lake temple, Git Git waterfall, a full day on Nusa Penida and the GWK park with Uluwatu at sunset.
included: Included: 5 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; Kintamani and jungle swing tour; Ulun Danu with Git Git waterfall; Nusa Penida west coast tour; GWK park with Padang Padang and Uluwatu.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
